dog.description_text:
Jolene will definitely take your man just because she can. This playful little pup is an extreme cuddle bug, pawing when you stop petting/paying attention to her. Yes her beauty is beyond compare with what some could argue flames of auburn hair, along with a tongue out when you carry her around. She will sing when she's hungry or thinks there's food not being shared. She loves playing with sister Dolly and resident pup Ruby, and with potty training coming along great, Jolene is ready to charm her way into a family of her own.

﻿Jolene is approximately 0y 4m 4d old and may be 26 to 32 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
